strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Rätsel, the ship has settled on the seabed@off Cape Nojima.
Will the data from Major Kai Kitamura lead to@clues about Major Sänger's whereabouts?
There's Axel's and Kota's cases, too.@It's too early to say.
By the way, have you sent word to@Commander Laker Randolf at Izu?
I've informed him of our objective through Gilliam.@Contacting him directly ourselves isn't@desirable at present.
But their superiors still@intend to use us, don't they?
Yes, Marshal Gaspar Gilan does.@As my father used to say, he's a sly one.
And once we're no longer useful, that's it?
If that comes about because the world@has found peace, it would be welcome.
With incidents like the <Cross Gate Burst>@still happening, that's a long way off.
Now... we'll likely be staying in Japan for a while.@We'd best resupply while we can.
Huh, what?@Axel and Alchemie are going to Tokyo alone?
We're wanted fugitives. We can't go running@a big investigation out in the open.
B-But it might be connected@to the <Cross Gate Burst>, right?
Yes.@Back then, something rained down upon the Earth.
Then shouldn't we explain to the <Steel Dragons>@and have them investigate?
With the aliens on the move,@I doubt they have room to spare.
So that's why you're going to look into it yourselves.
I don't know...@but I feel something is about to happen there...
Since it's Alchemie saying it,@I think it's worth believing, though.
Then I'll go too.@I've done part-time jobs in Tokyo plenty of times,@so I know my way around.
No, just us. We'll travel lighter that way.
(Doesn't seem like the mood to ask for souvenirs...)
...I haven't had enough. Let's hit one more place.
Nah, let's go home. Look, over there.
Due to the current state of emergency, going out@after 21:00 is prohibited. All citizens, please@return home immediately. Repeating...
What the heck, it's only 8 PM.
Shibuya got attacked the other day. That's why.
But the Federation Army drove them off, right?@These days, you can't get by if you're scared@of aliens and monsters. I'm used to it.
Still, there was that <Black Sky> incident too...@Things get crazier every year.
Online they're saying it's proof that@the end of the world is finally near...
People say that every time a big war@breaks out. Did the world end? Nope, right?
Sure, but the government and military@don't make the whole truth of the wars public.
Rumor has it a huge gate appeared up in the sky,@and it leads to heaven or hell...
And there's all sorts of other stuff...
Look, even so, we've gotta work@to put food on the table.@It's not like the government's paying us.
And we drink so we can work.@Not even the military has the right@to stop that...
They ate those people... What the hell are they?
...They seem to be... masses of negative emotion.
Negative emotion... If they welled up from the@<Cross Gate>, you'd think they were the <Ruina>.
They're similar, yet different...@If I had to compare them... dead spirits,@or vengeful ghosts.
Hmph... It's a little early for Halloween,@that's how it is.
Either way, your worries were right on the mark.
Tch, they don't just eat people?
Leaving them be is dangerous...@I shall summon the Persein.
Since we happened to be here, I can't ignore it.@Fine, go ahead.
Earth Federation Army Far East Command, Izu Base
New reports of unknowns@have been confirmed!
Multiple 20-meter-class unknowns have appeared in@Shinjuku, Shibuya and Ikebukuro. Their destructive@activity is causing damage to the city.
There are about 10 unknowns in each area,@but they seem to be multiplying gradually.
Most likely not. We checked the footage. They're@not mobile weapons, but something close to@the <Einst> or the <Yokijin>.
Scramble the <AM> squadron at Yokota.@Prioritize securing evacuation routes for@civilians over destroying the unknowns.
Understood. Also, the Red Ogre appeared@in Shinjuku a moment ago and is engaging@the unknowns.
The Red Ogre...@That should be under the Kurogane's command now.
Could it have something to do with the unknowns...?
Have you made contact with the pilot?
We're hailing it, but there's no response.
...Scramble the Steel Dragons as well.@Send them to Shinjuku.
I doubt Brigadier General Miles will move@without orders from the Joint Chiefs of Staff...
Naturally, it'll be with Paris's approval.@Also, treat the Red Ogre as a friendly unit@for the time being.
...Still no connection to the Joint Chiefs?
We keep calling, but there's no response.
(Do they not even have time to talk to me...?)
Could it be that over there, too...
Orders have gone out to each regional army, yes?@Then there shouldn't be any major problem...
Commander, videos that seem to be from Paris@are starting to be uploaded!@10... 20... more and more of them!
The same unknowns are in them...!
Transfer the Hiryu Custom to Paris at once!
Commander, the Hiryu Custom's spatial transfer@device is under maintenance and can't be used.
Parts of the device were removed and disassembled@for servicing. Even if we reassemble it now,@it won't be usable for 48 hours.
Don't tell me why it can't be done!@Think of a way it can!
(Fair enough, but think about@the situation we're in...)
Commander, may I offer my opinion?
The spatial transfer device is key to our operations.@If we halt maintenance now, it may be unusable@when we really need it.
Also, anticipating the missions we'll likely be@given, we should answer Izu Base HQ's request@and hurry to Shinjuku...
And gather combat data on the unknowns@while we can.
Ugh... Hmm.@You mean we do what we can right now.@Very well.
Understood. All hands, level one@battle stations. Heading for Shinjuku.
Captain, there are even more of them now!
Ngh! What's the civilian evacuation status?!
Police report level 5! There are unknowns in@Ikebukuro and Shibuya too, so Meiji-dori@can't be used as an evacuation route!
...! In Kichijoji too?!@Then Ome-kaido is also...!
Where are they coming from? With no gravity@quake readings, they don't seem to be@transferring in...
As you can see,@they seem to be welling up from deep underground.
From hell, you mean?@Has the Cross Gate nothing to do with it?
Either way, if they keep multiplying like that,@all of Tokyo might end up crawling with them.
If we could burn them all away at once, maybe...
Axel, reinforcements have arrived.@It's the Steel Dragons.
Commander, I'm launching the mobile units.
Good. Leave civilian evacuation support to that AM@unit. Don't let the unknowns out of this area.
Understood. XO, launch the mobile units.
This is the 1st Independent Special Unit, under the@Joint Chiefs. We'll handle the unknowns. Yokota@units, support the civilian evacuation.
Roger! Thanks for the assist!@All units, fall back!
(Human...? No, something else is mixed in...)
Major Kai, the <Telekinetic> pilots are reacting.@Careless contact might risk@mental contamination, wouldn't it?
Yeah... Like something's tingling@somewhere in my head...
Tenia said something kind of@psychic before, but...
Um... I'm feeling something similar too...
Oh my?@Isn't Alchemie riding with you?
That's right... Axel and I are one in body and soul.
We just happen to be riding together.
Alchemie foresaw their appearance.@Figures. Nothing good ever happens@when I run into you.
Do you know what they are?
Masses of negative emotion... That's all I know.
I suspected the same, but apparently they're similar@to the Ruina, yet different. More like ghosts,@according to Alchemie.
Ghosts? They sure look the part.
Don't tell me, since they're spirits,@our attacks won't work...
No, conventional weapons can destroy them.@The problem is...
That they keep welling up, one after another?
Right. For all we know, they're bottomless.
Th-Then if we can't finish them all...?!
You're sayin' it's gonna be a lot worse@than Asakusa gettin' hit?!
Even if they multiply endlessly,@they must need some source of energy.@If we can pinpoint it...
(Negative emotion...@Even if they're similar to the Ruina yet different,@if what they seek is the same...?)
Save the theories for later!@Raul, rescue any civilians left behind!
Telekinetics, keep your distance and attack!@Everyone else, move up and destroy the unknowns!
Save the theories for later!@Telekinetics, keep your distance and attack!@Everyone else, move up and destroy the unknowns!
Unknowns closing fast! Coming straight from@the Ikebukuro, Shibuya and Kichijoji areas!
Are any unknowns left in those three areas?
No, they're all converging on this combat area!
It's simple. They know our strength@and mean to surround and destroy us.
Oh my, like moths to a flame?
If anything, I think that's us...
Don't talk nonsense! Break through where they're thin!
Hmph, I've seen this situation somewhere before,@that's how it is.
Eleve 1 to all units!@Destroy them before we're completely surrounded!
All enemy signals in the combat area are gone!
Strange.@Before the Steel Dragons arrived, they were@multiplying at short intervals...
Units in need of resupply or repair, return to the@ship immediately. Everyone else, keep watch...
Incoming from Izu! Swarms of unknowns@have appeared in Yokohama and Osaka!
M-Multiple energy readings in the combat area!@It's the unknowns!!
